Limits of Metamorphic Testing for Object-Level
Authorization: Temporal Reachability, Oracle
Admissibility, and Measurement Resolution
QIULONG LIN 1,2 AND NANLEI CHEN 1,2
1Y ango University, Fuzhou 350015, China (e-mail: ubfbzu3@163.com)
2Sogang University, Seoul 04107, Republic of Korea
Corresponding author: Nanlei Chen (e-mail: ubfbzu3@163.com).
